panels.description: Authoritative current realtime strategy lease ownership from the bounded ingester profile registry.

targets.rawSql: SELECT strategy_key AS "Strategy", COALESCE(lease_owner, 'Unassigned') AS "Worker", desired_state AS "Desired State", observed_state AS "Observed State", desired_generation AS "Desired Generation", applied_generation AS "Applied Generation", heartbeat_at AS "Last Heartbeat", lease_expires_at AS "Lease Expires", CASE WHEN desired_state = 'running' AND (lease_owner IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= now()) THEN 'Unowned' WHEN desired_state = 'running' AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at > now() THEN 'Owned' ELSE 'Not requested' END AS "Ownership" FROM ingester.profiles ORDER BY strategy_key LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Current Strategy Ownership
